meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能分析蛋白质糖基化:扫描N-糖基化位点(N-X-S/T)、预测O-糖基化热点,并给出消除或添加糖基化位点的序列修改。用于抗体工程、疫苗设计等场景,可引用NetOGlyc、GlycoShield等外部工具。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析蛋白质糖基化、优化治疗性抗体或设计疫苗抗原等任务时触发。

say.text: 扫描这条氨基酸序列的N-糖基化位点
say.note: 返回位点位置、基序和上下文

say.text: 把第120位的天冬酰胺突变成谷氨酰胺,去掉这个糖基化位点
预测这条序列的O-糖基化热点
say.note: 给出Ser/Thr富集区域的候选位点

howto.what_en: Claude scans N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predicts O-glycosylation hotspots, and proposes sequence edits to add/remove glycan sites, referencing tools like NetOGlyc/GlycoShield for antibody engineering and vaccine design.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze protein glycosylation, optimize therapeutic antibodies, or design vaccine antigens.

say_en.text: Scan this amino acid sequence for N-glycosylation sites
Mutate position 120 Asn→Gln to remove the glycosylation site
Predict O-glycosylation hotspots in this sequence
